tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kye rdor mngon rtogs lam dus la nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris bzhugs so// kyai rdor mngon rtogs lam dus kyi skabs su nyer mkho la/ skyabs yul gsal 'debs kyi skabs su 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rags rim bsam nas/ de dag sdug bsngal las bral te byang chub la dgod pa'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang snyam du bsgom la/ de nas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad rang gi lus la bsdus shing / lus de yang 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skyes pa yin pas/ rim pa bzhin du bsdu ste/ de yang sa chu thim sogs nas/ thob pa 'od gsal la thim/ 'od gsal de dbang gi ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de'i rkyen gyis snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang / rang gi gtso byas sems can thams cad kye rdo rje'i rnam pa skyabs yul rnams kyang kye rdo rje'i rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /de yang rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i mdun gyi nam khar seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs bad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du ngo bo rang gi kye rdor gyi dbang thob pa'i bla ma rnams yin pa la rnam pa kye rdor yab yum sogs lha dgu/ rgyas par spro na bla ma'i mtha' skor du gdan de 'dra ba chung ngu re'i steng du/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs rtsa ba'i bla ma dang 'dra bas g.yas skor du bsam/ de'i mdun nam shar du yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs zhal phyag gsal ma nus kyang tshang bar bzhugs snyam pas chog g.yas su rigs lnga sogs longs sku/ bde gshegs mchod rten sogs chos sku/ rgyab kyi chos kyi skabs/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde sogs lung gi chos/ thugs rgyud kyi bde chen ye shes sogs rtogs pa'i chos so/ /g.yon du shā ri'i bu dang mau'u 'gal gyi bu sogs rab byung gi cha lugs rnams dang /

byams pa 'jam dbyangs sogs byang sems dang / gsang sngags kyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / mtha' skor du gur zhal sogs chos skyong rnams dang / dzam+bha la sogs nor lha rnams so/ /rgyas pa'o// ༈ /skyabs yul 'bring po ni/ gtso bo gong ltar gsal btab/ de'i spyi bor bla ma mi bskyod pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyi 'dus skur bsgom/ thugs ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūm̐ sangs rgyas/ sngags rnams chos/ sku yongs rdzogs skye mched kyi lha mtha' skor gyi sangs rgyas byang sems dge 'dun no/ /bsdus pa ni/ gtso bo bla ma tha mi dad sangs rgyas/ gsung chos/ sku dge 'dun/ rtogs pa dpe'i ye shes kyi tshul gyi rgyud la zhugs shing dbang gi bslab pa rang las rgan pa rnams dang 'khor gyi lha rnams dge 'dun no/ /de rnams kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed la 'chi srid kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dang / skye srid kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gnyis las/ dang po la sngar shi ba rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i bag chags/ da ltar gyi 'chi ba rnams ni sbyang gzhi/ 'byung ba rnams rim gyis bsdus nas dbang gi ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs par bsgom nas chos skur bsam pa ni sbyong byed mthar chos sku thob pa ni sbyangs 'bras so/ /gnyis pa la snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa/ bcud kyi sems can skye ba/ de yang sngar chags pa dang skye ba/ ma 'ongs pa na 'chags 'gyur dang / skye 'gyur/ da ltar gyi snod chags skyes thams cad ni sbyang gzhi/ 'od gsal de nyid dbang gi ye shes de nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen gyi phyi snod 'jig rten gzhal yas dang / nang rang gis gtso byas bcud kyi sems can gyi rdo rje'i lha dgu'i 'khor du bsgom pa sbyong byed/ de ltar bsgom pas gzugs kyi sku thob pa sbyang 'bras so/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag ni/ rang gi g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma sogs sems can thams cad kyis skyabs 'gro byed par bsam/

skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu 'jigs dad snying rje gsum las/ rgyu ni sems can thams cad kyi don du rang nyid dkon mchog gi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'o/ /dad pa dwang 'dod yid ches so/ /'jigs pa ni/ 'khor ba rang don/ yid byed tha mal snang zhen/ gya nom lhar zhen sogs dang / 'khor ba spyi bye brag tshe 'dir yang chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon sogs tshe 'di'i mi mthun phyogs dang / 'chi khar mtshams sbyor ngan pa dang / gnad gcad drag po dang / nad ngan sogs/ bar do'i 'jigs pa skye ba phyi ma mi khom pa'i gnas dang gnas ngan/ grogs ngan/ slob dpon ngan pa/ chos ngan pa sogs dam pa'i chos kyi 'gal rkyen du 'gro ba thams cad bskyab pa'i ched du 'o/ /dad pa'i don gzhan na gsal ba ltar rgyas bar dran par bya/ sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro dgos/ bla ma la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe sbyang gzhi rang gi nyon mongs pa dug gsum la sogs ba'i kun nas blangs te lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas mi dge ba'i las bsags pa thams cad/ sbyong byed bla ma la skyabs su song bas dbang bzhi thob par bsam pa'o/ /sbyangs 'bras lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag nas ngo bo nyid sku thob par bsam/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe/ sbyang gzhi zhe sdang gis kun nas blangs te yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad/ sbyong byed sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam/ sbyangs 'bras yid kyi dri ma dag nas sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi chos sku thob pa'o/ /chos la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe/ sbyangs gzhi 'dod chags kyis kun nas blangs te/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong byed chos la skyabs su 'gro bas/ gsang dbang thob par bsam/ sbyangs 'bras ngag gi dri ma dag nas chos dkon mchog longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'o/

/dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe/ sbyang gzhi gti mug gis kun nas blangs te lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad/ sbyong byed dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba'i bum dbang thob par bsam/ sbyangs 'bras lus kyi dri ma dag nas dge 'dun dkon mchog sprul pa'i sku'am/ go 'phang thob par bsam/ dpal ldan ni tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan pa'o/ /bla ma ni yon tan gyi khur gyis lci ba'o/ /dam pa ni dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas rang rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ /rnams zhes pa mang tshig ste/ tshigs bcad gcig la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin nos pa'i bla ma thams cad la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /tshigs gcig tsam ston pa'i slob dpon la'ang skyabs su 'gro zhing dam tshig bsrung dgos te/ gshin rje zhal drug pa'i rgyud las/ tshig gcig ston pa'i slob dpon la/ /slob dpon dag tu ma bzung na/ /skye ba lnga brgyar khyir skyes shing / /rme sha can gyi rigs su 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa la rme sha can sdig pa rā dza sogs te/ sdig pa rā dza'i bu rnams kyis pha ma za bar byed do/ /dam tshig ma bsrungs na de lta bu'i nyes pa 'byung ba'o/ /skyabs 'gro'i tshig don/ skyabs ni dkon mchog yin la/ 'gro ba ni de thob par 'dod pa'o/ /mthar bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ bdag la re sa ltos pa gzhan med/ da lta nyid du thugs rjes bzung snyam pas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog sogs kyis gsol ba btab ste/ skyabs yul bsdu ba ni/ 'khor rnams 'od zer dkar por gyur te rang gi dpral bar thim sogs la yang rgyas par bum dbang thob zhes sogs sbyar/ de'i tshe 'od zer rnams rang gi mtha' skor gyi sems can rnams la yang phog de thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas lus zag med gzugs kyi sku dang / sems rtog med chos skur gyur nas bya khyu la 'ur rdo rgyab pa ltar dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par mos/

rang sems gsal stong 'dzin med la ci gnas mnyam par bzhag de la don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro zer te/ gsal ba sprul sku dge 'dun stong pa chos sku zung 'jug long sku/ ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid sku bla ma'o/ /phan yon bslab bya sogs rgyas par gzhan du gsal/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas rang nyid 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel/ chos la skyabs su song bas chos 'khor bskor ba'i rten 'brel/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas theg pa che chung gi 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu 'du ba'i rten 'brel/ de dag ni rang gis thob pa'o/ /gzhan gyis rang nyid sangs rgyas pa la tshur skyabs 'gro byas nas sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel lo/ /sems bskyed ni/ skyabs yul rnam gsar du gsal 'debs mi dgos par/ mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams dpang por yod par dmigs/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod smon sems/ de'i ched du lha bsgom sngags bzlas sogs kyi lam zab mo nyams su len pa 'jug pa'o/ /rgyu byams snying rje med na sems bskyed mi 'byung bas de la nan tan bskyed/ gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus me 'bar ba lta bu/ rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus chu bo'i rgyun lta bu la 'bad/ sbyang gzhi byang chub kyi sems kyi 'gal rkyen gyi gtso bo ni zhe sdang sogs 'dra/ de yang sdig sgrib rnams kun gzhi skad cig ma'i steng du bsdus la/ kun gzhi bde chen gyi ye shes kyi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems su bsgom pa sogs 'dra/ ༈ /rdor sems skabs/ rang kyai rdor zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par gsal ba'i spyi bor/ bla ma dang gnyis su med ba'i rdor sems yab yum snang la rang bzhin med pa reg la ma 'byar ba che chung mtho gang ngam mtshon gang tsam gang mos bsgom/ sngags bzla ba'i dmigs pa thun mong ba kyus bzhin/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zab la 'chun che zhing gces spras su mdzad pa ni/

bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi smin mtshams yan chad gang bum pa'i dbang thob zhes sogs sbyar sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs gzugs med kyang 'od zer dang bdud rtsi sogs su bsgom pa dang / de bzhin du nad gdon sdig sgrib la gzugs med kyang dud khu dang rnag khrag dang / sdig pa dang dom la sogs pa srog chags kyi rnam pas 'thon pa ni thabs mkhas kyi khyad par ro// ༈ /lam byed bzhi'am drug ni/ de yang rang yi dam gyi lhar bsgom pa rnam pa lam byed gcig de yang kyai rdor dngos yin snyam pa mos pa lam byed gnyis pa/ de yang 'bras dus kyi kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa 'bras bu lam byed gsum/ de ltar bsgom pa la brten nas rang rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur bas byin rlabs drug tu byed na zhen pas 'jug pa'i lam ni 'bras bu la zhen pa'i sgo nas lam la 'jug pa'o/ /'brel bas mi bslu ba'i lam ni/ de ltar du zhen pa zhugs pas/ rgyu 'bras kyi dbang gis 'bras bu thob pa la mi bslu ba'o/ /tshogs shing spyan 'dren/ lha dbang du bsdu ba'i phyi pad+ma dmar/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad mtshon phyir 'dab brgyad do/ /sbyang gzhi de sbyong byed pad+ma snying rje'o/ /sbyangs 'bras sprul sku'o/ /nyi ma'i sbyang gzhi sems stong par zhen cing 'dzin pa/ sbyong byed shes rab stong nyid nyi ma sbyang 'bras chos sku/ hūm̐ ni sbyang gzhi rang sems kun gzhi/ sbyong byed thabs shes zung 'jug gi ngo bo hūm̐ du bsgom/ sbyangs 'bras longs sku'o/ /rdo rje thal mo thabs shes zung 'jug mtshon no/ /lha mo brgyad mchod skabs/ thod pa rnams lha thams cad kyi phyag g.yon par phul/ sha chen gyi dwangs ma klad pa/ cang te'us mchod pa lnga ka mtshon/ lha mo rnams kyi mtshon don ni/ nga'o snyam pa'i bdag 'dzin gyi dri mas ma gos pas dkar mo/ rnam rtog bcom pas chom kun ma/

rnam rtog gi srog bdas nas bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi ro langs pas ro langs ma/ nyon mongs rnam rtog za bas za phod ma/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis sbos pas sbos mo/ rnam rtog gis dben pas ri khrod ma/ rnam rtog gsod pas gdom mo'i gtum mo/ g.yung mo ni 'jig rten na rigs ngan gyi bu mo la gzhan gyis mi reg pa ltar nyon mongs rnam rtog tshur mi reg go /gtso bo yab yum ni bdag 'dzin gyi dri mas ma gos pas bdag med ma/ kye rdo rje ni thabs shes dbyer med do/ /sdom bzung tshe rang gi chos ming nas smos/ ye shes tshogs/ snang bcas snang tsam ma 'gags pa/ me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ snang med stong nyid 'od gsal du bsgom/ sngags don/ mchog ster stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin nga'o/ /zhes so/ /rwa gur bar du bar stong cha chen gcig gur rtser gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga phyed pa'i tog rak+ṣa gsum gyis bdag nas rnal 'byor bsrung / srung 'khor rgyud las hūm̐ bkod par bshad kyang / bla ma 'di man ngag gis gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba bh+rūṃ las bskyed par gsungs pa'i don/ bh+rūṃ gyi klad kor ma dang / ra ta'i ra gnyis la ra ces pa gnod byed/ khog pa'i ba la rkyen la sbyin pa'i ba la re stobs/ ha dang ra la/ ras ra ta'i ri la ha ra te 'phrog pa/ mdor na gnod byed kyi stobs 'phrog pa ste/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba bsgom pa/ gnod pa phyir bzlog la shin tu bsngags/ dngos bstan sku gsung thugs byin gyi rlabs pa/ gsungs kyang / man ngag gi gti mug rdo rje sogs/ nyi ma'i steng du bsrung bya rnams sngags/ na maḥsogs nas tsakra warti yan gyis gnyis bskor ther ba'ang snang bskor bar bsam/ gnad lngas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs/ gzhan la bar chad byas pa/ mdor bsdus na phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang / nang bcud kyi sems can gnyis su 'du/

phyi snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong byed du/ gzhal yas khang / bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa bsgom/ nang bcud kyi sems can sbyang ba'i don du/ lha dgu'i don bskyed chog bsgom pa rnams/ gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin/ yang dag par na sbyong byed gcig gis sbyang gzhi mtha' dag sbyong ba dang / sbyong gzhi gtso 34che ba gcig sbyong byed mang pos sbyong ba dang / sbyong byed gcig gis sbyang gzhi mang po sbyong ba sogs mang du shes dgos so/ /de yang lam byed bzhi'am drug gi sgo nas nyams su len/ bre phul rin po che dkar/ gser gdung gi steng nas nang gi lcam sne cha phran gnyis phyir 'char bar thog phub pa bya 'dab/ de la thur du spyi blugs lta bu mda' yab/ steng du drwa ba mig bseng la byang chen mchod rten lta bu pu shud/ rta babs nang ngos glang rgyab mig gsum cha phran phyed bskos bar gnam rgyan/ rdo rje'i gdung 'og tu rwa ba 'obs kyi tshul du 'dod pa/ thog thag tu 'dod pa rwa ba'i tshul du 'dod pa gsum las phyi ma rang lugs/ sgo'i rnam gzhag la/ sgo gcig pa dang / sgo brgyad pa dang / gru bzhi sgo bzhir bshad pa yod kyang 'dir phyi ma'o/ /srid rtse nas dmyal ba'i bar gyi snod gzhal yas khang gis sbyong / dur khrod ni ro'i gnas te/ ro la bdag med pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa rang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa mtshon phyir/ 'dzam bu'i gling na mkha' 'gro stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pa'i yul stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod la/ de yul sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'dus/ de nyi shu rtsa gnyis su 'dus/ de bcu gnyis su 'dus/ de brgyad du 'du bas dur khrod brgyad/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas ni/ srung 'khor gyi phyi rol du sgom pa dang / srung 'khor thun mong ba'i nang / thun mong ma yin pa'i phyi ru bsgom pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i nang chos 'byung gi phyi ru bsgom pa dang /

chos 'byung gi nang gzhal yas khang gi phyi ru sgom par gsungs pa rnams las/ 'khor 'das dbyer med mtshon phyir gang du bsgoms kyang mi 'gal mod/ dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud las/ dur khrod rnam pa bzhi ru 'gyur/ dang po phyi'i dur khrod ni rdo rje rwa ba'i nang rol lam/ yang na phyi'i grangs rnams su/ zhes sogs/ nang lus/ gsang ba dbugs rgyu de kho na sangs rgyas kyi mtshan ma/ da ris tshos 'byung gi phyi ru bsgom/ lus dang srid pa 'jig rten chos brgyad sbyong zhing lha dang 'byung po dbang du 'du ba'i dgos pa/ gtor mgron gyi gnas nges par bya ba'i dgos pa/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum bsres nas nyams su len pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dag bya dag byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ dag bya/ phyi nang gnyis kyi dang po ni/ phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi brgyad phyi rol gyi dur khrod brgyad du snang ba/ nang lus kyi sna bug gnyis gcig bsdoms pa'i bu ga brgyad dur khrod brgyad/ de la zug pa'i rtsa brgyad shing brgyad sogs tshang / dag bya phyi'i dur khrod brgyad po dag par byed pa ni gzhal yas khang gi dur khrod brgyad de/ ma dag ba'i snang ba dang cha 'dra yang ma dag pa dngos min de/ ye shes kyi snang ba yin pas so/ /gzhan yang dur khrod brgyad sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs gnas brgyad rnam par dag shing brgyad kyi byang chub shing rnam par dag sprin brgyad kyi byang chub sems rnam par dag me brgyad kyi ye shes brgyad rnam par dag chu brgyad kyi thugs rje chen po brgyad dag phyogs skyong brgyad sangs rgyas rabs bdun/ rje btsun byams pa dang brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad nyan thos brgyad rnam par dag go /mngon byang skabs su khams gsum 'khor bar zhen pa sna tshogs byed pa'i las sgrib thams cad/ rang gi lus sems gnyis su 'dus/ de yang sems su 'dus/ de yang rang skye ba'i rgyu pha ma'i byang sems dkar dmar ā li kā lir bsgom/

de yang tshes gcig nas bco lnga la nyin mtshan gnyis su phye bas bcu drug tshes gcig la rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong nang gi khams a thung ngur gnas pa sogs dang / dmar cha la 'byung bzhi nam mkha' dang lnga/ lnga po la yang dga' ba bzhi bzhis phye sogs/ thabs dkar dmar gyis shes/ thabs shes kyis/ de dbang gi ye shes su byin gyis rlabs pa'i ye shes mngon byang lnga la sogs par bsgyur nas nyams su len/ yum gyi phyag g.yon thod pa byang sems dmar pos gang ba/ yab kyi phyag g.yas dang po'i glang po che kha nang / g.yon gyi sha ra bha pha khyung ma seng / 'bir rdzi 'brum bu/ sems can thams cad kyi nad srog chags brgyad la/ de rang la bsdus nas bde chen gyi ye shes su bsgyur te/ skye rga na 'chi med ba'i thun mong dngos grub thob/ 'khor lo mi rus la bris nas bseng / mgrin rgyan sked rgyan la mchod lha/ thod phreng rgyu rlon la ma le phug nas so/ /yum mkha' pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad sems can la rjes su chags pas dmar/ tshad med bzhi dang bsdu dngos bzhi mtshon pas 'dab brgyad/ yum rang bzhin gyi skye med mtshon pas ze 'bru āḥyis mtshan pa/ stong phyag bcu drug nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab bcu drug gi dngos 'dzin gyi mgo bcad pas thod pa bcu drug thabs la snying rje bcu drug dga' ba bcu drug bde stong zung 'jug yul can ye shes bcu drug srog chags de dag thod pa'i nang du tshang ba ni/ sngon 'byung bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag g.yas pa'i phyag mtshan rnams las 'od zer spros nas sems can thams cad kyi nad rnams bsdus nas zhi bar mdzad pa yin/ rjes 'jug gis kyang de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ rgyu nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong med par 'gyur/ de med pas 'bras bu nad brgyad khri bzhi stong med/ de med pas bkres skom 'chi sogs med do/ /rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa pha ma'i ting nge 'dzin/

lha mo dbyung ba spun zla'i༞ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /sems dpa' gsum brtsegs ni sprul longs chos gsum gyi ngo bo'o/ lha mo rnams la ni pad zla ro/ /ye shes pa dgug gzhug gi dgos pa gser 'gyur ram/ ti tshas zangs kyi mdog bsgyur ba slar zangs su mi 'gro ba ltar/ rang kyai rdor lha dgu rten dang brten par bcas pa la/ kyai rdor lha dgu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs nas bstims pa slar rang tha mal du mi 'gyur cing / rigs drug tu ltung mi srid de/ yo ga rdo rje rtse mor/ ji ltar rtsi yis zangs phug na/ /slar yang zangs su 'gyur mi srid/ /de bzhin ye shes lus phug na/ /slar yang 'gro drug lhung mi srid/ /ces gsungs pas 'di la nges shes 'drongs ba gal chai/ nang dkyil skabs mda' drwa rgya gram/ mgo bo ri rab stod cha/ mgo'i zur bzhir lha gnas kyi khang chung bzhi lta bur bsgom/ zhar byung skabs/ yul gyi lha mo drug rnams kyi zhon pa'i rlung yin pas thams cad kha dog nag mo zhal nang gzigs/ skye mched kyi lha mo drug zhal phyir gzigs te/ yul yul can zhal sprod/ rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga sbyor tshul sogs kyi bshad pa bde chen bcud snying nas gsal/ dbang lha rgyas par na gzhal yas khang gi nang gtso bo smin mtshams kyi thad du/ gzhal yas khang grub bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i nang du/ lha snam rim gnyis/ legs dgu sogs/ da lta phyag len lam dus skabs/ khri zlum po bang rim gsum pa mdzad/ rig dbang gi swa bha wa'i skabs/ rgyas par/ rang nyid phyi dkyil lha dgu nang dkyil lha brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun/ zhar byung gi lha nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa'i phung khams skye mched/ dbang rdzas bcas stong par sbyangs/ sbyang gzhi phung sogs ni/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi ngo bo'i rnam shes ni rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid/

de lta bu bag chags kyi tshul du spung pa phung po/ de la stong par sbyangs/ des kun la 'gre ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'i tshe/ 'od zer lha mo bzhi spros te/ mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du cha gcig rang gis spyi bo nas thim lus dkyil gsal 'debs cha gcig dbang rdzas la thim/ tshor ba'i mtshan nyid ngo bo bde sdug btang snyoms gsum/ rten gyi sgo nas drug ni mig gis 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba sogs/ yul gyi bye brag ma 'dres par mtshan mar 'dzin pa 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de yang sngo ser sogs don dang / pho mo sogs tha snyad la mtshan mar 'dzin pa ste/ yul gyi spu ris so sor 'dzin pa'i mtshan rtog gi bag chags sogs/ 'dus byed ni yul phan tshun phrad pa sogs/ gzugs ni gzugs su rung ba ste gzugs rdzas nyi shu sogs dbang rdzas 'grim tshe/ phyi dkyil gyi gtso bo'i spyi bor bum pa bzhag pa'i dus su/ bum pa de las mang po spros te/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi spyi bor bzhag pa sogs rigs 'gres/ de ltar na brtan g.yo'i snod bcud phyi nang gis ngo bos thams cad khams drug yul sogs dang sbyar ro/ /rdor sems g.yas rkyang g.yon bskum 'di rang bzhin rnam dag gi lha ste/ sgom med bsgom pa po yang med sogs dang sbyar/ rdo rje 'chang sngon po gnas gsum byin rlabs byed pa yang snang ngo / /mi ldog sogs dbang bzhi rdzogs pas sngags sdom thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis gsol btab thun mong bar 'dod/ slob ma dang slob dpon gyi dpang gnyis char la dbang stegs bsgom/ sbyang gzhi dam tshig gsum gyi chags nyams/ sbyong byed dam tshigs gsum byin pa/ bsrung tshul bsdu na sgo gsum dam tshig nyid ces pa gnad kyi don/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi 'jug tu dbang lha rang la mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du bstim pa'ang snang / dbang rdzogs rjes mdun gyi dbang lha rten dang brten par bcas pa 'od du zhu phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi spyi bo nas thim pas/

sku lus kyi nang thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang / chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs bdag gis rgyas btab/ rigs bdag rnams ni rang 'od kyi yum dang bcas longs sku'i cha byad can no/ /nang mchod skabs/ thod pa'i nang du zla ba shar nas dpral ba'i ngos su'o/ /sha lnga ni/ ba lang sogs kyi ro yongs rdzogs kyi rnam pa dbus kyi mi ro gan rgyal du yod par/ phyogs bzhi'i ro rnams kyang 'gyel nas mgo dbus su bstan pa'o/ /rlangs pa tsha la bdud rtsi rgyun grang / bdud rtsi'i he ru ka yang sku mdog dkar/ phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rang nyid phyi nang lha tshogs thams cad kyi/ ljags kyi hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga nas 'bras tsam las 'od kyi sbu gu byung / bdud rtsi drangs te myangs pas mgrin pa yi/ rtsa 'khor gang zhing gzhir gnas bdud rtsir 'dres/ /zag med bde ba chen pos gang bar bsgom/ spyir dag pa zhes pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag par bzhag pa dang / rtags sam mtshon byed la dag par bzhag pa dang / dri ma dag pa la dag par bzhag pa dang gsum/ 'dir gnyis pa ltar rtags sam mtshon byed la dag par bzhag pa yin/ dwangs1 ma khrag2 sha3 tshil4 rus5 rkang6 khu ba7 lus zungs bdun yin ces pa'i phyi shun 'o ma la skris ma chags pa lta bu'i pags pa bdun/ byang chub sogs/ thod/ rkang / rtsib/ tshigs rus rigs bzhi/ bden pa sogs/ dag pa dran pa 'dir byas na mnyam bzhag tu bsdu/ bzlas pa'i rjes dang spyod lam gyi skabs su yang rung / bzlas pa'i sngags 'khor gyi tshe zhi ba la/ sngags phreng 'od zer dkar po 'phro bas rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rje byin rlabs 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par sngags phreng la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ rgyas pa sogs la yang lde kha bsgyur/ bzlas pa'i rjes su mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'dus par bsgom pa dang /

lha rnams kyi spyi bor rigs bdag rnams gsal btab ste/ zhwa phud thal mo sbyar te ngag tu/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs nas gsol/ de'i thabs su bdag gi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis dang / lam rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin dang rtogs pa bzang po khyad par can skye ba gnas pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlabs du gsol dang yig brgya lan gsum brjod pas ting nge 'dzin dang rtogs pa brten par bsam/ byin gyis rlobs phyir rdo rje'i glu len sogs/ gtor mchod bshams la rang lugs las 'jam po gsum la gnyis ka g.yas skor/ drag por de las bzlog sgra don ba liṃ zhes pa nus pa'i stobs la 'jug ste/ rang gzhan tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor thob pa'i stobs dang / nus pa bdud 'joms pa ste/ a mṛ ta zhes pa bdud rtsi'o/ /bod skad gtor ma zhes pa thams cad la gtor bas gtor sdang zhen med par sbyin pas ma zhes so/ /dang po mchod pa byin rlabs byed pa'ang snang / chos 'byung gsum gyi bad+ma dkar sngo dmar/ 'gron bsdu tshe steng gi sa bla ni/ gzugs khams gzugs med/ sa steng na gnas pa 'dod lha drug nas mkha' 'gro 'byung po sogs gling bzhi'i mi'o/ /sa 'og na gnas pa ni/ ngan song gsum dang / lha ma yin dang klu'o/ /byin gyi rlabs pa ni ye shes pa spyan drangs pa sogs/ mchod pa'i tshe rang gi snying kha nas zhabs bsil ma dkar mo dung phor dri bzang gi chus gang ba thogs pa spros te lha rnams kyi zhabs bkru bar bsam/ de bzhin du zhal bsil ma dkar mos zhal/ 'thor 'thung ma dkar mos sku kha dri bzang gis byugs/ mchod yon ma dkar mos mchod yon zhal du'o/ /gtor ma'i dmigs pa 'dra/ gtor sngags phe ṭa ga ta yan pra pri ta'i skad/ mar los saṃ skri tar 'khrul gsung / de nas me tog ma sogs spros te mchod/ lag g.yon nang mchod 'thor tshe lha thams cad kyi phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re byung bar bsam/

mkha' 'gro spyi gtor skabs phaiṃ ni/ phe em zhes bod skad mgo khos zer/ lha yin kyang dam tshig nyams na mgo khos zer ba'o/ /sngags brgya 'dis mgron mi 'byon dbang med/ dur khrod brgyad ni rdo rje gdan gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad na gnas gsung / 'jig rten pa'i sde brgyad rgyal po rmu btsan sogs/ rgyud sde 'og mar gsung pa'i sde brgyad cha gsum gyi phul/ gsang sngags bla med las gsungs pa'i sde brgyad lha'i tshogs rnams zhes sogs yin/ de rnams 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung nas/ gtor ma phul na'ang rung / rnam pa de dang der bsgom nas phul na'ang rung / yi dam gyi lhar bsgom nas phul na'ang rung bas/ gsang sngags bla med kyi kun rdzob kyi snang ba thams cad lhar bsgom/ rang 'od dpag med kye rdo rjer bsgom la rdor glu dang / gtor mgron bsnyes par bsam te/ me tog gi char phab/ bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol te bdag rgyud la/ spang dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams can gong nas gong du rgyas par bsam zhing / gtor mgron rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa la smon lam gyi dpang po zhus te/ rigs su skye dang sogs/ 'di dag ni zla zer sogs su mi gsal ba'i gsung sgros 'ga' re'i brjed tho/ mkhas pa rnams kyi thugs mi khrel bar zhu/ zhes pa chos smra ba'i btsun pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ kye rdor mngon rtogs lam dus la nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
